caption_L1: This line plot is called Thirty day prevalence of use of any illicit drug for grades 8 , 10 and 12 combined from 1991 to 2019. The y-axis plots Percentage of respondents as linear scale with a minimum of 0.00 and a maximum of 0.20 while the x-axis plots Response using linear scale of range 1995 to 2015.
caption_L2L3: The X-axis plots years increasing in increments of 5. The Y-axis ploys percentage of respondents increasing in increments of 0.05. The lowest percentage of respondents was just over 0.10 around 1992. The highest percentage of respondents was around 1996 at over 0.20. There was a sharp increase in the percentage of respondents from 1992 to 1996, from its lowest to highest. Since 1996 there has been an overall decline in the percentage of respondents.
